from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A named person or entity involved in the case."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="Full name or identifier of the party as stated in the text")
    role: str | None = Field(description="Role in the case, e.g., appellant, defendant, applicant")

class MonetaryAmount(BaseModel):
    """Specific monetary figures cited in the judgment."""
    description: str | None = Field(description="What the amount refers to, e.g., 'compensation', 'court fee'")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical amount")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency or unit, e.g., 'yuan'")
    payer: str | None = Field(description="Who is required to pay, if mentioned")

class RulingDecision(BaseModel):
    """A specific order or decision made by the court."""
    action: str | None = Field(description="The action taken, e.g., 'dismiss', 'compensate', 'maintain'")
    target: str | None = Field(description="What is being decided, e.g., 'appeal', 'lawsuit', 'request'")
    text: str | None = Field(description="The verbatim text of the decision")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judicial document for matching against outcome options."""
    document_titles: list[str] = Field(description="Title or header of the judgment document")
    case_numbers: list[str] = Field(description="Case reference numbers mentioned in the document")
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="All named parties in the case with their roles")
    monetary_amounts: list[MonetaryAmount] = Field(description="Specific monetary values and obligations stated")
    ruling_decisions: list[RulingDecision] = Field(description="Specific court orders and decisions")
    case_nature: list[str] = Field(description="Type of dispute, e.g., 'infringement', 'inheritance', 'administrative'")
    procedural_stage: list[str] = Field(description="Procedural status, e.g., 'second instance', 'retrial review'")
    conclusion_text: list[str] = Field(description="The final ruling text or paragraph to be matched against outcomes")
